claim: In-app messaging is the highest-leverage growth lever for SimpleApp

angles.name: industry_competitive
angles.instruction: Survey 5+ peer content-feed products. What messaging features did they ship, what retention lift did they report?

angles.name: internal_owners
angles.instruction: Who owns messaging at SimpleApp's parent org? What internal UXR exists on messaging engagement and churn correlation?

angles.name: problem_framing
angles.instruction: Decompose 'growth lever' — what other levers exist (onboarding, push notifs, recommendation tuning)? How does messaging compare in opportunity size?

angles.name: measurement
angles.instruction: How would we measure messaging's growth contribution? What A/B design? What's the leading indicator vs. lagging metric?

angles.name: adjacent
angles.instruction: What new messaging tech (AI summarization, video DMs, etc.) is the domain not pricing in?

angles.name: user_research
angles.instruction: What do user interviews / surveys say about messaging behavior on SimpleApp specifically? Where is the demand actually coming from — convenience, social pressure, content sharing?
